g.text: Non-Functional Study - Interoperability, Scalability, Cost, Security
One node per machine costs more
Summarizes the main non-functional design considerations for
the documentation phase. It explains how the selected ESP32,
MQTT, local sensor wiring, and optional RS485 path affect
ESP32 per machine + local wired sensors + MQTT over Wi-Fi
Whether sensors, ESP32 nodes, gateway, and cloud can exchange data through clear standards
How easily the design grows from one machine to many machines
Hardware, wiring, setup, and maintenance effort tradeoffs
Protection for device access, network traffic, dashboard use, and stored data
The recommended documentation baseline used by all diagrams
